scientific_limitations_and_integrity: Exact finite computation for the 325 \(\mathbb F_{16}\)-rational lines on the smooth Hermitian quintic surface in characteristic two. The claim does not determine the index in the full numerical cycle lattice. General rank and characteristic-primary support use cited literature. The full text of Shimada (2001) was not retrieved; an exact special-case result there remains a residual bibliographic risk.
title: The exact Smith form of the Hermitian quintic line lattice
